decisions.reason: The subject placeholder wording does not change the document's default Word language configuration.
The source specifies subject placeholder text but does not change whether placeholders clear when activated.
The localized subject placeholder has no entailed effect on legacy-content transfer or formatting stability.
The source does not discuss pasted tables, columns, page margins, or layout stability.
The subject placeholder wording does not alter bullet sizing, balance, alignment, reference design, or color.
The source supplies text for a subject field but does not change the selected text-entry representation or architecture.
The source has no effect on Tab-based list input, applicable list styles, or hierarchy behavior.
The source changes placeholder wording only and specifies no typography change.
The subject placeholder text does not change the requirement to include customer theme colors.
The source distinguishes the existing date text from the subject text but does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method.
Providing a localized subject placeholder does not change the existing requirement that interactive-field help labels be present.
The source specifies placeholder wording but does not resolve or change the visual cue used to identify editable fields.
